name: build_plan
notes: input.profile is the normalized Profile (the output shape of clusters_parse_profile); input.ask is dataclasses.asdict(slurm.Ask). `arb submit` fills the Ask before build_plan: partition = profile.default_partition, nodes = 1, mem_gb/cpus = null unless given, walltime_s = parse_walltime(--time), repeat = secrets.token_hex(4) with --repeat. output is Plan.request() (what goes into runs.request_json before submit adds command_source/base_command/overrides/override_style/parent_run) plus three Plan fields: billed_per_node, max_walltime_s and over_billed. est_su = round(sum(billed_gpus * s / 3600 * charge), 2) with Python's round() (correctly rounded on the exact binary value, ties to even: 0.125 -> 0.12, 0.375 -> 0.38). Default mem = floor(gpus_per_node_asked * mem_per_gpu_gb) (never rounded up: 4 x 110.898 -> 443).
